versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Semantics of the aggregation NvBlockSwCompo- nentType . bulkNvDataDescriptor The existence of an aggregation at meta-class NvBlockSwComponentType in the role bulkNvDataDescriptor indicates that read-only access to a block of data in non-volatile memory shall be provided. Access to this block of data is provided directly from non-volatile memory as op- posed to via a RAM mirror.
